summary: Frontend-focused verification of iteration 4 UI/security changes (Orders nav link removal, admin-only master orders list, checkout 'How it works' card). All three requested features PASS. Backend spot-checks confirm /api/admin/orders is admin-gated (401 anon, 403 customer, 200 admin) and /api/orders is user-scoped.

minor.issue: SellAuth returns 422 'email must be valid' BEFORE the subscription-plan error, so backend maps it to HTTPException 502 (SellAuthError). Cloudflare then replaces the 502 body with its own HTML page, so the user does not see the intended plan-gate message inside data-testid=checkout-error (they see a Cloudflare 502). Pre-existing account/edge behavior; not caused by this iteration. Consider mapping SellAuth errors to 400/409 with our own JSON detail so Cloudflare does not strip the response.

action_items: (Optional / not blocking) Map SellAuth non-plan errors to a non-5xx status (e.g. 400 with detail) so the friendly message reaches data-testid=checkout-error instead of being replaced by the Cloudflare 502 page.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx correctly removes data-testid=nav-dashboard from BOTH desktop and mobile menus; admin-only 'Admin' link is properly gated by user?.role === 'admin'.
Checkout.jsx renders data-testid=checkout-how-it-works as the first child inside the credential fieldset, with guest-email-input above it (guest) and PTC inputs after — DOM order verified.
server.py: GET /api/admin/orders is the ONLY endpoint returning all orders (Depends(get_admin_user)); GET /api/orders is scoped to caller user_id — verified via curl.

Minor: 'How it works:' heading uses Tailwind uppercase class so screen readers/plaintext will read 'HOW IT WORKS:'. The literal string 'How it works:' is in the DOM source so exact-text matching still succeeds. Acceptable.

Checkout 'How it works' card is in correct DOM position for both guest and logged-in flows and renders cleanly at 390x844 (no overflow, scrollWidth=298 <= clientWidth=298). Admin /admin page + Orders tab + reveal-creds-{id} + set-status-processing-{id} buttons all render (10 orders present). /dashboard route still reachable directly. NOTE for next iteration: /api/orders/checkout currently returns HTTP 502 through Cloudflare (Cloudflare intercepts the body) — this is a preview-env quirk of using 5xx statuses; the underlying backend correctly raises SellAuthError with the plan/email message but the user only sees the Cloudflare page. Not in scope for this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The Cloudflare 502 on /orders/checkout is a status-code-mapping side effect (backend raises 502 for any non-plan SellAuth failure; Cloudflare replaces 502 bodies with its own error page). Fix option: return 400 with JSON detail instead of 502 for SellAuthError.
